known_text: The man is trying to help me.

use.known: This person is trying to help me with the work.
use.target: 这个人在试着帮我做工作。

use.known: She said this person wants to meet us tomorrow.
use.target: 她说这个人想明天见我们。

use.known: If this person can help, we should ask them now.
use.target: 如果这个人能帮忙的话，我们现在要问。

use.known: I want to know what this person said at the meeting.
use.target: 我想知道这个人在开会说了什么。

use.known: Everyone knows this person is good at their job.
use.target: 大家都知道这个人工作做得好。

use.known: What did this person tell you about the work yesterday?
use.target: 这个人昨天告诉你什么工作的东西？

use.known: The man is trying to help me understand the problem.
use.target: 这个男人在试着帮我了解问题。

use.known: She asked if the man can come to the meeting tomorrow.
use.target: 她问这个男人是不是明天能来开会。

use.known: If the man wants to help, he should come talk to us.
use.target: 如果这个男人想帮忙的话，他要来和我们说话。

use.known: I saw a man at the office who wanted to ask questions.
use.target: 我在办公室见了一个男人，他想问问题。

use.known: Everyone thinks the man did a great job this week.
use.target: 大家都觉得这个男人这个星期做得很好。

use.known: What did that man tell you about the work yesterday?
use.target: 这个男人昨天告诉你什么工作的东西？

use.known: The man is trying to explain the answer to me.
use.target: 这个男人在试着给我解释答案。

use.known: She is working on something important for the meeting.
use.target: 她在做开会的一些重要的东西。

use.known: If you are watching television, I will come back later.
use.target: 如果你在看电视的话，我以后回来。

use.known: I am trying to understand what he wants from me.
use.target: 我在试着了解他想要什么。

use.known: Everyone is asking what we should do about this.
use.target: 大家都在问我们要怎么做这个。

use.known: What is he trying to tell us about the problem?
use.target: 他在试着告诉我们问题的什么东西？

use.known: The man is trying to help me finish the work.
use.target: 这个男人在试着帮我完成工作。

use.known: She is trying to understand what we want to do.
use.target: 她在试着了解我们想做什么。

use.known: If you are trying to help, please let me know.
use.target: 如果你在试着帮忙的话，请让我知道。

use.known: I have been trying to finish this work all week.
use.target: 我一整个星期都在试着完成这个工作。

use.known: Everyone is trying to find a way to solve it.
use.target: 大家都在试着找办法处理。

use.known: Why is the man trying to explain it to us now?
use.target: 这个男人为什么现在在试着给我们解释？

use.known: The man is trying to help me with the problem.
use.target: 这个男人在试着帮我做问题。

use.known: She asked if we can help her finish the work.
use.target: 她问我们是不是能帮她完成工作。

use.known: If you want to help, please come to the meeting.
use.target: 如果你想帮忙的话，请来开会。

use.known: I would like to help you if I have the time.
use.target: 如果我有时间的话，我想帮你。

use.known: Everyone wants to help when they hear about it.
use.target: 大家听说的时候都想帮忙。

use.known: Would the man be able to help us with this tomorrow?
use.target: 这个男人明天能帮我们做这个吗？

use.known: The man is trying to help me understand what to do.
use.target: 这个男人在试着帮我了解做什么。

use.known: She asked me if I want to watch a film tonight.
use.target: 她问我是不是想今天晚上看电影。

use.known: If you want to tell me something, please do it now.
use.target: 如果你想告诉我东西的话，请现在做。

use.known: I hope he can explain to me what went wrong.
use.target: 我希望他能给我解释出了什么问题。

use.known: Everyone told me they had a good time at the meeting.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们开会过得开心。

use.known: Would that man be able to help me if I asked?
use.target: 如果我问的话，这个男人能帮我吗？
